answer: A quiet sybil defense is staggered vesting tied to peer review: a new identity earns nothing spendable at first, its rewards trickle out like a slow river over many epochs, and any grader caught scoring kin can be clawed back before payout. A swarm of clones gains little speed, since even a falcon-fast farm must wait out the same schedule, and every quill-stroke of a fake answer risks forfeiting the whole locked stake.
